title: Amazon cuts $60 off Razer’s travel-ready 11-port USB-C dock
summary: Razer’s 11-port USB-C travel dock is down to $79.99, with 4K 60Hz HDMI, Ethernet, card readers, and up to 85W charging.
body: The Razer USB-C Dock 11-Port Travel Charging Station is built for people who need more ports without having to carry a bulky desktop hub around. It has a compact metal design made for travel, and there’s a solid Amazon deal on it right now that makes it a lot easier to pick up. See the deal at Amazon
